Subject: Discovery recap and decision path

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation earlier today. Quick recap of what we heard on your side and a proposed decision path so we can keep momentum. Please flag anything I missed or items you want reworded.

Top pain points you called out:
- High latency on current on-prem LLMs for live triage workflows (95th percentile spikes to ~1.8s per token for long contexts).
- Unit cost is unpredictable when traffic peaks; procurement needs clear SLO-based pricing.
- PHI handling and auditability — security/compliance is the gating item for any pilot.

Primary goals:
1) Run a 6-week pilot that demonstrates stable 95th percentile latency < 250ms for short-turn queries and < 600ms for longer threads.
2) Verify data handling controls (VPC, KMS, audit logs) for PHI workloads and collect SOC2 evidence.
3) Establish a procurement path and target TCO for scaling to 10M tokens / month.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high-level) — please confirm owners and adjust dates if needed:
- Pilot scope signoff (deliverable: pilot_scope.pdf) — Owner: Samantha Liu — Target: 2026-10-08
- Security review & evidence exchange (deliverables: SOC2 summary, audit keys) — Owner: Tom Reynolds / Security — Target: 2026-10-15
- Procurement terms & pricing approval (deliverable: SOW + pricing) — Owner: Crescent Procurement / Ben Carter — Target: 2026-10-22
- Pilot run (6 weeks) — Owner: Crescent Engineering / Redwood delivery — Start: 2026-10-25 — End: 2026-12-06
- Production go/no-go review & executive signoff — Owner: Samantha Liu + Redwood CS — Target: 2026-12-10

Immediate asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm the two internal sponsorship names for security and procurement?
2) Are the target dates above realistic, or should we slide the security review a week earlier?
3) I attached a draft pilot scope for your review (pilot_scope.pdf) and a recording of today’s demo (link below).

Next step: If those dates look OK, Ben will draft a short SOW and a pricing sketch for the procurement track by next Wednesday. I can set a 30-minute sync on 10/05 to walk through the MAP with your procurement lead.

Thanks — appreciate the clarity on the risk profile.

—

Mina — thanks for the tidy summary. Looks accurate overall; a couple of clarifications below.

1) Internal sponsors: Security lead is Tom Reynolds (cc’d), Procurement lead is Angela Park (procurement@crescenthealth.com) — I’ll loop her into the next thread.
2) Security review: we’d prefer the evidence exchange earlier if possible. Can we aim to have the SOC2 summary and initial architecture diagram by 10/12? Our security team has windows Oct 13–16 for an in-depth session.
3) Procurement timeline: we typically require a 2-week internal review once a draft SOW is shared. We’ll attach our standard procurement checklist for the SOW review.

I’ve attached our internal procurement timeline to this reply (procurement_timeline.xlsx). Also added a few minor scope asks in the pilot PDF: data residency in US-East and explicit KMS key rotation cadence.

Small edit to MAP dates based on the above: move security review target to 2026-10-12, procurement approval to 2026-10-29. Pilot start remains dependent on procurement but tentatively 2026-11-01 if procurement closes on 10/29.

We’re keen to get a short SOW — thanks Ben in advance for picking that up.

Best,
Samantha
Director, Product Integrations
Crescent Health

Attachments: procurement_timeline.xlsx
